Correlation between the errors of WorkReach and the benchmark models, and
out-of-sample performance under a stratified five-fold split on origin zones.

## Setup

```{python}
import sys

sys.path.append("..")
sys.path.append(".")

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from data_processing import load_and_prepare_data, preprocess_data
from evaluation import common_part_of_commuters
from models import (
    optimize_utility_model,
    optimize_gravity_pow_model,
    optimize_radiation_extended,
    optimize_bms_plausible_model,
)
from cross_validation import FIT_FUNCTIONS, MODEL_NAMES, cpc, stratified_splits
from si_plots import (
    plot_error_correlation_heatmaps,
    plot_error_correlation_scatter,
    plot_oos_scatter,
    plot_train_test_performance,
)
```

## Configuration

```{python}
FIGS_DIR = "../../figs/SI"
os.makedirs(FIGS_DIR, exist_ok=True)

CITY_ORDER = ["Bay Area", "Los Angeles", "Mexico City", "Rio de Janeiro"]
BENCHMARKS = ["Gravity", "Radiation Ext", "BMS Plausible"]

CITY_PATHS = {
    "Bay Area": ("../../data/h3_bay_8.geojson", "../../data/bay_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Los Angeles": ("../../data/h3_la_8.geojson", "../../data/la_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Mexico City": ("../../data/h3_cdmx_8.geojson", "../../data/cdmx_flows_h3_8.csv"),
    "Rio de Janeiro": ("../../data/map_informality_eci.geojson", "../../data/rio_flows_h3_8h3.csv"),
}
```

## Load Data

```{python}
city_prep = {}

for city, (mzn_path, flows_path) in CITY_PATHS.items():
    _, _, dist_m, eci_m, flows_m, home_m, inf_m, _ = load_and_prepare_data(
        mzn_path, flows_path, city
    )
    eci_raw = eci_m.values.astype(float)
    informality_raw = inf_m.values.astype(float)

    (distance, distance_log, eci, flows, informality, home_population,
     work_population, *_) = preprocess_data(home_m, dist_m, eci_m, flows_m, inf_m)

    city_prep[city] = {
        "distance": distance, "distance_log": distance_log, "eci": eci,
        "informality": informality, "flows": flows,
        "home_population": home_population, "work_population": work_population,
        "eci_raw": eci_raw, "informality_raw": informality_raw,
    }
```

## Fit Every Model

```{python}
all_models = {}

for city in CITY_ORDER:
    prep = city_prep[city]
    models = {}

    models["WorkReach"] = optimize_utility_model(
        prep["distance_log"], prep["eci"], prep["flows"], prep["informality"],
        prep["home_population"], True, city
    )
    models["Gravity"] = optimize_gravity_pow_model(
        prep["distance"], prep["home_population"], prep["work_population"], prep["flows"]
    )
    models["Radiation Ext"] = optimize_radiation_extended(
        prep["distance"], prep["home_population"], prep["work_population"], prep["flows"]
    )
    models["BMS Plausible"] = optimize_bms_plausible_model(
        prep["distance"], prep["home_population"], prep["work_population"], prep["flows"]
    )
    all_models[city] = models

    observed = prep["flows"].flatten()
    for name, (_, prediction) in models.items():
        value = cpc(observed, prediction.flatten())
        r = np.corrcoef(observed, prediction.flatten())[0, 1]
        print(f"{city:16s} {name:14s} CPC = {value:.3f}  r = {r:.3f}")
```

## Residual Correlation

```{python}
residuals = {}

for city in CITY_ORDER:
    flows = city_prep[city]["flows"]
    off_diagonal = ~np.eye(flows.shape[0], dtype=bool)
    residuals[city] = {
        name: flows[off_diagonal] - prediction[off_diagonal]
        for name, (_, prediction) in all_models[city].items()
    }

corr_tables = {
    city: pd.DataFrame(
        [[np.corrcoef(residuals[city][a], residuals[city][b])[0, 1] for b in MODEL_NAMES]
         for a in MODEL_NAMES],
        index=MODEL_NAMES, columns=MODEL_NAMES,
    )
    for city in CITY_ORDER
}

for city in CITY_ORDER:
    print(f"\n{city}")
    print(corr_tables[city].round(3))
```

```{python}
fig = plot_error_correlation_heatmaps(corr_tables, CITY_ORDER)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/error_correlation_heatmaps.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```

```{python}
fig = plot_error_correlation_scatter(residuals, CITY_ORDER, BENCHMARKS)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/error_correlation_scatter.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```

## Out-of-Sample Evaluation

```{python}
fold_results = []
oos_predictions = {}

for city in CITY_ORDER:
    prep = city_prep[city]
    observed = prep["flows"]
    off_diagonal = ~np.eye(observed.shape[0], dtype=bool)
    oos_predictions[city] = {name: np.zeros_like(observed) for name in MODEL_NAMES}

    for fold, (train_mask, test_mask) in enumerate(stratified_splits(prep)):
        for name in MODEL_NAMES:
            fit = FIT_FUNCTIONS[name]
            kwargs = {"city": city} if name == "WorkReach" else {}
            _, prediction = fit(prep, train_mask, **kwargs)

            oos_predictions[city][name][test_mask, :] = prediction[test_mask, :]

            row = {"City": city, "Fold": fold, "Model": name}
            for split, mask in (("Train", train_mask), ("Test", test_mask)):
                split_observed = observed[mask][off_diagonal[mask]]
                split_predicted = prediction[mask][off_diagonal[mask]]
                row[f"{split} CPC"] = cpc(split_observed, split_predicted)
                row[f"{split} r"] = np.corrcoef(split_observed, split_predicted)[0, 1]
            fold_results.append(row)

    print(f"{city}: folds complete")

results_df = pd.DataFrame(fold_results)
```

```{python}
for city in CITY_ORDER:
    observed = city_prep[city]["flows"].flatten()
    for name in MODEL_NAMES:
        predicted = oos_predictions[city][name].flatten()
        value = cpc(observed, predicted)
        r = np.corrcoef(observed, predicted)[0, 1]
        print(f"{city:16s} {name:14s} out-of-sample CPC = {value:.3f}  r = {r:.3f}")
```

```{python}
fig = plot_train_test_performance(results_df, CITY_ORDER, MODEL_NAMES)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/train_test_performance.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```

```{python}
city_flows = {city: city_prep[city]["flows"] for city in CITY_ORDER}
model_order = ["Gravity", "Radiation Ext", "WorkReach", "BMS Plausible"]

fig = plot_oos_scatter(oos_predictions, city_flows, CITY_ORDER, model_order)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/train_test_oos_scatter.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```
